contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN CONST[ANTI]VS PF AVG ; R/ FEL TEMP REPARATIO

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Emperor on galley issue of 348-350, Trier mint, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN CONST[ANTI]VS PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor standing left on galley holding labarum, Victory steering in stern. Reverse inscription: FEL TEMP REPARATIO. In exergue: possibly TRS. Diameter: 24.2mm, Weight: 4.57gms, die axis: 6
